items.q: Should I repair or replace my water heater?
items.a: If it's under about [8] years old and the tank isn't leaking, repair is usually worth it. If the tank itself is leaking or the unit is past [10–12] years, replacement is the better investment. We'll tell you which before we quote.

items.a: Yes. We handle plumbing for new construction, remodels and additions. Share the plans and existing conditions so we can discuss the work.
